_comment: Copy to shunt.local.json and edit. Never committed: it holds the choices that belong to this machine rather than to the repository. Overrides shunt.json; environment variables override both.

_notes.profile: Which worker does the bulk reading. Must name a profile from shunt.json.
_notes.writerProfile: Which worker generates files. Defaults to the active profile if omitted.
_notes.project: Vertex also reads GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT from the environment, so this can be left out if that is set.
_notes.allowedProviders: Optional whitelist of providers permitted to see this code, e.g. ["ollama"] for a repository that must not leave the machine. Applies to every role.
